description: Executable conformance contracts for the Go listener and four engine dialers.

cases.title: Configuration and address validation have no side effects
cases.preconditions: Fresh process with transport, goroutine, timer, unlink, and allocation probes.

input.constructed: Every valid/invalid address row and optional configuration boundary.

cases.action: Construct each row; Open only accepted rows.
cases.wire_result: Rejected rows access no endpoint; accepted rows derive exact platform bytes.
cases.api_result: Typed result and documented defaults match each row.
cases.cleanup: Rejected rows own nothing; close accepted objects.
cases.failure_evidence: Fixture row, expected/actual bytes, error kind, first side effect.

cases.title: Construction, token generation, and Decode are pure and typed
cases.preconditions: Entropy/codec seams visible; caller configuration mutable after construction.

input.constructed: Generated tokens, copied config, valid values, nil/invalid Decode targets.

cases.action: Generate, construct without Open, mutate caller state, and Decode boundaries.
cases.wire_result: No probe, handle, endpoint, goroutine, timer, or bytes.
cases.api_result: 32 lowercase hex secure token, frozen config, explicit Decode result.
cases.failure_evidence: Token format, mutated field, target type, observed side effect.

cases.title: Open protects the listener before traffic
cases.preconditions: Canonical endpoint absent; security and traffic observers active.

input.constructed: One valid endpoint per platform.

cases.action: Open; probe intended local and forbidden remote/wrong-user access.
cases.wire_result: Unix stream mode 0600; Windows byte-stream pipe with intended-user ACL and remote rejection; protection precedes traffic.
cases.api_result: Open returns listening without waiting and never uses TCP.
cases.cleanup: Close removes Unix node or releases pipe handles.
cases.failure_evidence: Platform, mode/ACL/transport, first-traffic order.

cases.title: Endpoint liveness and stale cleanup are deterministic
cases.preconditions: Live endpoint, busy Windows pipe, refused Unix stale node, unrelated path.

input.constructed: Each native liveness result without sleeps.

cases.action: Open a second client for every condition.
cases.wire_result: Live/busy is never replaced; only refused Unix node is unlinked before bind.
cases.api_result: Live returns endpoint_live; stale succeeds; unrelated path unchanged.
cases.cleanup: Close owned listeners and reacquire endpoint with fresh object.
cases.failure_evidence: Liveness result and ordered path/handle operations.

cases.title: Listening and connected are distinct states
cases.preconditions: Fresh client, multiple WaitConnected callers, controllable Open failure.

input.constructed: Failed-open retry then valid candidate.

cases.action: Observe states and cancel one waiter.
cases.wire_result: Handshake only after accept; waiter cancellation emits no bytes.
cases.api_result: Open failure restores new; listening has no Session; remaining waiters share ready view.
cases.failure_evidence: Ordered state/event and waiter results.

cases.title: Invalid candidates do not consume the slot
cases.preconditions: Listening client, candidate diagnostics, no session.

input.constructed: Short ACK, invalid selection, PID mismatch, malformed assignment, disconnect, valid candidate.

cases.action: Submit invalid candidates separately, then valid one.
cases.wire_result: Invalid candidate closes without framed pre-session error; valid candidate establishes.
cases.api_result: Typed diagnostic has no epoch/lifecycle event and slot remains free.
cases.failure_evidence: Candidate ordinal, bytes, diagnostic/status, slot state.

cases.title: Exactly one session is established
cases.preconditions: One session and extra native dialers.

input.constructed: Extra dials before and one dial after disconnect.

cases.action: Attempt candidates while connected and after loss.
cases.wire_result: Extra candidates get no handshake; one later candidate may establish.
cases.api_result: Active epoch, callbacks and negotiation stay unchanged.
cases.failure_evidence: Dial ordinal, bytes, epoch, callback trace.

cases.title: Go sends exact handshake and validates ACK plus assignment
cases.preconditions: Protected listener; peer splits every exchange at each byte.

input.constructed: All split points.

cases.action: Dial, read handshake, return split ACK/assignment, record readiness.
cases.wire_result: Exact 16-byte handshake, exact 4-byte ACK, immediate assignment, no interposed frame.
cases.api_result: Connected only after complete assignment and ready dispatch.
cases.failure_evidence: Split point, offset, expected/actual hex, event order.

cases.title: Encoding and capability negotiation are exact
cases.preconditions: Separate candidate for every ACK selection.

input.constructed: Unadvertised, multi-bit, empty selections.

cases.action: Establish or reject each candidate.
cases.wire_result: Only one offered encoding and exact capability subset accepted.
cases.api_result: Valid view immutable; invalid ACK closes candidate with typed error.
cases.failure_evidence: Offered/selected masks and error/status.

cases.title: Frames, bounds, fragmentation, and Control decode defensively
cases.preconditions: Established JSON/MessagePack sessions with allocation, read, clock, and event probes.

input.constructed: Reserved flags, wrong channels, malformed codecs, short prefixes, stream splits, timeout/capacity boundaries.

cases.action: Run each input in an isolated epoch.
cases.wire_result: Valid dispatch once; oversize rejected before allocation; safe fatal error then EOF; pong repeats seq.
cases.api_result: 403/404/413 distinct; unknown valid Control ignored; partial input never succeeds.
cases.failure_evidence: Vector/recipe, offset, allocation/read, status, event trace.

cases.title: Correlation and messages route without overlap
cases.preconditions: Correlation session, concurrent requests, Messages consumer, virtual timeout.

input.constructed: Concurrent IDs, timeout/reuse, late reply, unsolicited frame, application error.

cases.action: Send/request, time out/reuse, inject late and unsolicited traffic.
cases.wire_result: Replies repeat IDs; application errors stay application frames; fire-and-forget has no prefix.
cases.api_result: Replies only Request, unsolicited only Messages, late reply neither.
cases.failure_evidence: Epoch, ID lifecycle, destination, frame hex.

cases.title: Heartbeat and IPC progress while handlers are slow
cases.preconditions: Session below capacity, barrier-blocked callback, virtual deadlines.

input.constructed: Traffic, send, close, request/fragment deadlines while blocked.

cases.action: Block handler, run IPC/deadlines, release handler.
cases.wire_result: Reads, writes, pong, heartbeat, timeouts, rejection, close meet bounds.
cases.api_result: Callbacks serial, ordered, and lock-free for public methods.
cases.failure_evidence: Operation timestamps/deadlines and callback order.

cases.title: Bounded queues fail terminally on backpressure
cases.preconditions: Default/configured capacities; consumers paused; terminal observer active.

input.constructed: N entries then N+1 for Messages and callbacks.

cases.action: Fill each queue independently and overflow once.
cases.wire_result: IPC never blocks indefinitely; affected epoch closes; later work stops.
cases.api_result: N ordered entries, reserved error/disconnect, no silent drop.
cases.cleanup: Drain, fail requests, return listening, close.
cases.failure_evidence: N, accepted count, overflow ordinal, cause, drain order.

cases.title: Session loss returns to listening without process policy
cases.preconditions: Session with accepted events, requests, fragments; no process helper.

input.constructed: Peer disconnect then application-initiated later dial.

cases.action: Disconnect, observe drain, establish replacement.
cases.wire_result: Old partial/unsent work discarded; listener sends fresh handshake later.
cases.api_result: Requests session_closed; accepted events precede disconnected; no spawn/restart.
cases.failure_evidence: Epochs, event order, request results, process operations.

cases.title: Close is permanent, idempotent, and leak-free
cases.preconditions: Clients blocked in accept, handshake, I/O, wait, request, callback, heartbeat.

input.constructed: Close each state, repeated/inside-callback Close, fatal accept failure.

cases.action: Trigger terminal action and bounded completion.
cases.wire_result: All endpoint/session resources close; no later bytes.
cases.api_result: Work unblocks typed; Messages closes; no later callback; reopen forbidden.
cases.cleanup: Assert zero handles, goroutines, timers, queues, waits, requests.
cases.failure_evidence: State, blocked operation, elapsed bound, resource inventory.

cases.title: New epoch rejects every stale authority
cases.preconditions: Old/replacement sessions with captured sends, responders, timers, fragments, correlations, events, callbacks.

input.constructed: Release each old authority after replacement.

cases.action: Attempt each stale action.
cases.wire_result: No stale bytes; replacement unchanged.
cases.api_result: Epoch nonzero/increasing; stale work typed or discarded without new event.
cases.cleanup: Close replacement and release old state.
cases.failure_evidence: Authority, epochs, bytes/events, replacement state.

cases.title: Executable public surface is client-only and schema-free
cases.preconditions: Consumer build and negative API probes.

input.constructed: Positive Client API; negative non-Go client, engine listener, Runner requirement, process policy, arbitrary address, application envelope.

cases.action: Compile/import probes and round-trip scalar/list/map payloads.
cases.wire_result: Opaque values encode directly; no lifecycle/schema field added.
cases.api_result: Only contracted surface compiles; Runner not needed.
cases.cleanup: Close and remove harness artifacts only.
cases.failure_evidence: Probe source/diagnostic and encoded value.

cases.title: Every client error kind is distinguishable
cases.preconditions: Deterministic trigger for every CLI-ERR ID including callback/OnError panic.

input.constructed: Expected kind, phase, epoch, status, terminality table.

cases.action: Trigger rows and inspect errors.Is/errors.As/events.
cases.wire_result: Only permitted bytes; no success fallback.
cases.api_result: Kind, English cause, phase, epoch, status, terminal count match.
cases.cleanup: Close or verify teardown each row.
cases.failure_evidence: Expected/actual fields, duplicates, unexpected success.

cases.title: Configuration validation is pure and snapshot-based
cases.preconditions: Dial, endpoint, thread/task, timer, caller-mutation probes.

input.constructed: Every invalid/default option and mutation during blocked connect.

cases.action: Create; connect valid rows; mutate caller config; release seam.
cases.wire_result: Invalid rows never dial; valid attempt uses frozen values only.
cases.api_result: Defaults/validation match ENG-CFG; no retry.
cases.failure_evidence: Field, value, timing, first side effect, error.

cases.title: Canonical address is byte-identical
cases.preconditions: Controlled temp/filesystem encoding seams.

input.constructed: Valid, invalid, changed token/name, macOS boundaries.

cases.action: Begin connect and observe target or pre-dial rejection.
cases.wire_result: Exact fixture address; no normalization/relocation/truncation/fallback.
cases.api_result: Invalid/overlong typed before dial.
cases.failure_evidence: Row and expected/actual target bytes.

cases.title: Every engine is only a native dialer
cases.preconditions: Private Go listener owns/protects canonical endpoint; TCP trap active.

input.constructed: Unix stream on Linux/macOS; byte-stream pipe on Windows.

cases.action: Connect once and inspect transport/endpoint operations.
cases.wire_result: Only dial; never bind/listen/accept/probe/unlink/change ACL or use TCP.
cases.api_result: Connect reaches handshake on required transport.
cases.failure_evidence: Ordered transport trace and mutation.

cases.title: Dial failures are explicit and grant no ownership
cases.preconditions: Absent, refused, denied, busy, timed-out endpoints.

input.constructed: Each failure then later ready Go listener.

cases.action: Connect once per failure; retry only by later application call.
cases.wire_result: No create/remove/replace/security operation and no hidden retry.
cases.api_result: Dial/timeout causes distinct; explicit later connect may succeed.
cases.failure_evidence: Condition, attempt count, cause, time, mutation trace.

cases.title: Handshake is exact and invalid input writes nothing
cases.preconditions: Private listener splits/terminates handshake at each offset.

input.constructed: Empty/short reads, PID mismatch, canonical invalid inputs.

cases.action: Separate connect per input; capture output to EOF.
cases.wire_result: Parse after 16 bytes only; invalid closes with zero ACK/Control/application bytes.
cases.api_result: 400/401/402/415/read/transport typed; no session event.
cases.failure_evidence: Offset, input/output hex, status, phase, events.

cases.title: Encoding and capability intersection are deterministic
cases.preconditions: Each valid preference/capability configuration.

input.constructed: Known/reserved bits and intersection outcomes.

cases.action: Connect rows and compare ACK bytes.
cases.wire_result: First configured common encoding; exact implemented intersection.
cases.api_result: Immutable session view; invalid config pre-dial.
cases.failure_evidence: Preferences, masks, ACK hex.

cases.title: ACK and assignment establish in exact order
cases.preconditions: Valid handshake and output/event recorder.

input.constructed: Valid printable session IDs at 1/128-byte boundaries.

cases.action: Connect and record writes/state/view/events.
cases.wire_result: Exact ACK then one assignment with nothing between.
cases.api_result: Success/connected only after assignment write and dispatch ready.
cases.failure_evidence: Byte/event/state order and ID boundary.

cases.title: Establishment write failure creates no session
cases.preconditions: Valid handshake; partial/failed ACK/assignment writes.

input.constructed: Failure at each output byte.

cases.action: Connect per injected failure.
cases.wire_result: Only written prefix appears; close; no later frame.
cases.api_result: One phased error; no connected/disconnected; idle.
cases.failure_evidence: Offset, prefix, phase, event count.

cases.title: State machine rejects duplicate connect
cases.preconditions: Dial/handshake barriers and established session.

input.constructed: Second connect while connecting/connected; operation while closing.

cases.action: Invoke duplicates at each state.
cases.wire_result: No duplicate dial/handshake; original unchanged.
cases.api_result: Exact state sequence and already_* or session_closed.
cases.failure_evidence: States, results, dial count, epoch.

cases.title: Close is idempotent; reconnect is explicit
cases.preconditions: Engines idle, connecting, connected, blocked in owned work.

input.constructed: Repeated close each state then later application connect.

cases.action: Close repeatedly, observe silence, explicitly reconnect.
cases.wire_result: Transport closes; no automatic dial; Go endpoint untouched; explicit call dials.
cases.api_result: Idempotent; cancelled connect session_closed; idle terminal state.
cases.failure_evidence: State, connect count, resources, endpoint metadata.

cases.title: Frames and oversize bounds are exact
cases.preconditions: Sessions with allocation/read probes and split writes.

input.constructed: Every split and 16 MiB boundaries.

cases.action: Send valid/oversized frames in isolated epochs.
cases.wire_result: Valid dispatch once; oversize before body read/allocation; Control error last.
cases.api_result: Opaque valid input; one 413 disconnect.
cases.failure_evidence: Offset, declared/allocated/read size, output, events.

cases.title: Malformed frames never partially deliver
cases.preconditions: One compatible session per malformed input.

input.constructed: Reserved flags, LAST-only, bad channel/direction, short prefix, malformed codecs.

cases.action: Inject each and capture events/output.
cases.wire_result: No partial message; safe failure sends one 403 then closes.
cases.api_result: One protocol error and reasoned disconnect with epoch.
cases.failure_evidence: Mutation, offset, events, status, final frame.

cases.title: Fragmentation is bounded and epoch-local
cases.preconditions: Short timeout and active limit one.

input.constructed: Changed prefixes, interleaving, timeout, capacity, cumulative oversize, reconnect reuse.

cases.action: Run valid and invalid sequences separately.
cases.wire_result: Valid emits once; invalid yields exact 403/404/413 before unsafe allocation.
cases.api_result: No partial delivery; no state survives terminal boundary.
cases.failure_evidence: IDs, prefixes, size/count, status, epoch.

cases.title: Correlation preserves responder authority
cases.preconditions: Correlation/baseline sessions and pending-ID probes.

input.constructed: Success, application error, double response, reuse, timeout, late reply, unnegotiated use.

cases.action: Receive, respond, exercise lifecycle, reconnect for stale tests.
cases.wire_result: Response uses Data and repeats the correlation ID; invalid or stale writes nothing/closes per protocol.
cases.api_result: Responder only correlated, single-use, epoch-bound.
cases.failure_evidence: ID lifecycle, calls, frame hex, epoch.

cases.title: Public sends are directional, ordered, and await writes
cases.preconditions: JSON/MessagePack sessions, order recorder, injected write failure.

input.constructed: Valid output channels, forbidden Control/directions, serialization/size/stale/write failures.

cases.action: Submit and await each send; capture peer order.
cases.wire_result: Only valid directions/codec; sequential order; failures never succeed.
cases.api_result: Explicit result and documented concurrent order; no envelope.
cases.failure_evidence: Submission/completion order, codec, frame, error.

cases.title: Control and fatal ordering are exact
cases.preconditions: MessagePack application session with Control recorder.

input.constructed: Unknown valid type, malformed JSON/type, post-error send.

cases.action: Send each Control input separately.
cases.wire_result: Control JSON; same-seq pong; unknown ignored; fatal last/no later output.
cases.api_result: Never application message; malformed 403; peer code preserved.
cases.failure_evidence: Semantic input/output, seq/code, events, EOF order.

cases.title: IPC progresses independently of slow handlers
cases.preconditions: Session below capacity, blocked handler, virtual clock.

input.constructed: Read/write/pong/heartbeat/expiry/close while blocked.

cases.action: Block handler, advance IPC/deadlines, close, release.
cases.wire_result: IPC/timers meet bounds without application logic on IPC path.
cases.api_result: Serial lifecycle order; public methods need no callback lock.
cases.failure_evidence: Handler interval, IPC times, bound, event order.

cases.title: Backpressure is terminal and observable
cases.preconditions: Paused dispatcher at default 64 and capacity N.

input.constructed: N complete events then N+1.

cases.action: Fill, overflow, drain.
cases.wire_result: IPC does not block; session closes; later work rejected.
cases.api_result: N ordered then reserved error/disconnect; terminal result backpressure.
cases.failure_evidence: N, counts, overflow, reserved order, terminal result.

cases.title: Callback failures and TypeScript turns are observable
cases.preconditions: Failing message/lifecycle/error observers and TypeScript turn probes.

input.constructed: Throw/reject/panic each observer; two TypeScript callbacks.

cases.action: Trigger failures and verify distinct TypeScript turns.
cases.wire_result: Terminal cause governs transport; TypeScript timers/close advance between callbacks.
cases.api_result: Application error once; native uncaught once; no recursion.
cases.failure_evidence: Language, ordinal, uncaught count, turn, terminal result.

cases.title: Disconnect clears session state before idle
cases.preconditions: Session with fragments, correlations, timers, queued sends, responder, events.

input.constructed: Go/local close, heartbeat timeout, protocol/transport failure.

cases.action: Trigger each reason and record cleanup/order.
cases.wire_result: No old output after teardown; Go endpoint untouched.
cases.api_result: One reasoned disconnected; state cleared before idle.
cases.failure_evidence: Trigger, reason, order, resource inventory.

cases.title: Replacement epoch rejects stale work
cases.preconditions: Captured old authorities and replacement session.

input.constructed: Release each authority after explicit reconnect.

cases.action: Attempt stale work against current session.
cases.wire_result: No stale bytes; replacement unchanged.
cases.api_result: New ID; nonzero increasing epoch; stale typed/discarded.
cases.failure_evidence: Authority, epochs/IDs, bytes/events, state.

cases.title: Every engine error kind is distinguishable
cases.preconditions: Deterministic trigger for each ENG-ERR ID and observer failure.

input.constructed: Expected kind/phase/status/epoch/terminality table.

cases.action: Trigger rows; inspect result/events/terminal result.
cases.wire_result: Only permitted bytes; no empty/success fallback.
cases.api_result: Typed fields and single cause match even if observer fails.
cases.cleanup: Close or verify idle each row.
cases.failure_evidence: Expected/actual fields, terminal result, duplicates.

cases.title: Public surface has no listener, client, Runner, or schema policy
cases.preconditions: Normal consumer build/import and negative probes for every SDK.

input.constructed: Positive engine API; negative listener/server/accept, public client, Runner requirement, arbitrary address, process policy, envelope.

cases.action: Run probes and scalar/list/map round trip.
cases.wire_result: Only dial; opaque values unchanged by schema policy.
cases.api_result: Required operations compile; forbidden public probes fail.
cases.failure_evidence: SDK, probe source/diagnostic, encoded value.

cases.title: Environment adapter is configuration-only
cases.preconditions: Valid/missing/malformed environment rows and transport/process probes.

input.constructed: YUUMI_ENDPOINT_NAME and YUUMI_TOKEN rows.

cases.action: Invoke adapter only.
cases.wire_result: No dial/listener/spawn/discovery/retry/supervision/bytes.
cases.api_result: Valid EngineConfig or typed configuration error.
cases.failure_evidence: Variable state, result, first forbidden effect.

cases.title: Cleanup and runtime constraints hold for four engines
cases.preconditions: Each SDK blocked in dial, handshake, I/O, dispatch, heartbeat, close.

input.constructed: Every language/platform pair with bounded teardown.

cases.action: Inject close/runtime failures each phase.
cases.wire_result: Transport closes; no endpoint mutation/later output.
cases.api_result: Work stops; Python explicit daemon threads, Rust stable callbacks, TypeScript yields, errors typed.
cases.failure_evidence: SDK/platform/phase/time/error/resource inventory.

legacy_cases_removed.reason: Engine close now releases dial/session resources only.

legacy_cases_removed.title: Endpoint and session failures remain isolated
legacy_cases_removed.reason: Accept-loop coverage was replaced by dial/session cases.
